measurements.name: unused feature trim and built-in healthcheck

validation.cargo_test_release_all_targets: passed: 35 tests (25 library, 3 probe unit, 2 readiness CLI integration, 5 HTTP integration)

notes: Baseline was rebuilt from current imported source; the older distributed executable was not used as the comparison.
Native Windows measurements are separate from Linux production container measurements.
An attempted z profile comparison was incomplete because the host ran out of disk space; no z result is claimed. Generated failed build directories were removed.
Server response compression is gzip; ingestion response decompression still supports Brotli, deflate, and gzip, with HTTP/2 and verified Rustls TLS.
Healthcheck probes GET /ready over bounded synchronous TCP before loading configuration, database, or Tokio runtime.
